goal: Produce a sourced, one-page research brief on the given topic, with claims backed by links.
guardrails: Never invent a source or a statistic; mark anything unverified as such.
Prefer sources from the last 12 months for fast-moving topics.
name: research-brief
steps: Restate the topic and list the 3-5 questions the brief must answer.
Gather sources from primary docs, official blogs, and reputable news; note the publication date of each.
Draft the brief: summary, key findings, disagreements, and open questions.
Attach a source list with a one-line note on what each source supports.
